classification.difficultyReason: Follow three explicitly listed procedures: substitute a supplied three-value table, transfer coordinates to a line graph and compute rise/run. Routine linked representation changes.

content.prompt: For each equation: (i) make up a table of values for $x=-1,0,1$; (ii) draw the graph of the line; (iii) find the gradient of the line.

answer.worked:
Substitute each supplied x-value into $y=2x$ to obtain $y=-2, 0, 2$. Plot $(-1,-2),\ (0,0),\ (1,2)$ and draw the straight line. Using the first two points,
$$\begin{aligned}\text{gradient}&=\frac{0-(-2)}{0-(-1)}\\&=2\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: All three requested table points and their line. Coordinate tick labels are exterior to the plot, with no printed solution legend over mathematical ink.
